description: A level-2 order book snapshot for a Coinbase pair: best bid and ask, mid price, spread in price and basis points, and the top bids and asks up to depth 50. It is a snapshot, not a quote: prices move between calls. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
